definitions.instance_e2e_s: wall time from instance admission before conversation construction until the final round is recognized as finished; excludes final result serialization and checkpoint writes
definitions.round_e2e_s: wall time from the start of a model round through generation and, when used, tool result conversion into the next-round input
definitions.generation_batch_wall_s: synchronous wall time of the whole model batch; shared by all requests in that batch and not summed for throughput
definitions.backend_request_metrics: per-request vLLM metrics when exposed by the installed vLLM version
definitions.tool_latency_s: wall time of one ToolManager.call_tool RPC
